buildAssessment.summary: Proceed. The build passes every hard blocker and meets every requirement. It delivers the 202 enqueue endpoint, a worker-only insert, the entity, the migration and the wiring. It also applies the Product Owner's 503 deadline and the 20-level depth limit, and the 400 and 503 paths are tested. A live run was observed and recorded. The handoff on the card is complete and honest: AC8 stays unchecked, as the Product Owner directed, pending mise trust. Weaker points: the service layer throws an HTTP exception, several fixes came out of review rather than test-first work, and the e2e test for "400 enqueues nothing" covers only one invalid case.

grade.summary: Proceed. The stage shaped the task without failing any hard blocker, and all five requirements pass. Two weaknesses lower grades. First, the NUL-character case is left as an open probe for the build stage to decide. Second, failure behavior when Redis is down appears in the notes but not in the acceptance criteria. Observability and carry-forward therefore get B. Decision quality gets A: the questions were genuine product decisions with recommendations grounded in the brief. Scope discipline gets A: the Product Owner approved occurredAt, the exclusions are explicit, and rejected options carry their reasoning. The diff touches only AGENTS.md and GLOSSARY.md, so no application code was written.
